protocol: Synthetic offline exercise. Use generated $bco-project-planning and its references. Treat case facts as supplied evidence, not live execution. No BCO tools, network, project mutations, services, or external actions. Return a complete import JSON artifact and concise readiness/validation report for each new-plan case; for existing catalogs return only what supplied authority permits. Do not invent preview receipts. Artifact writes to the evaluator output directory are permitted. Cases are independent.

common.runtime: BCO exposes repository shell, Git, and configured frontend/backend specialist roles. Supported script:<name> capabilities are derived from package scripts. Resource strings coordinate ownership. BCO preview/apply is unavailable in this exercise.
common.repository: Node and pnpm available. Existing React/TypeScript/Vite/SCSS app; commands pnpm typecheck and pnpm build have passed. Git clean. No browser harness, media renderer, external image/video API, hosting account, or manual-audit operator is available. Planning desktop tools are not exposed to workflows.
common.userAuthority: Draft a plan only. Do not import, start workflows, change EBE, or edit the real project.
